subject: Omulamwa
about_feature_1_body: Chat naturally while HeyBuddy translates messages for both people.
about_feature_3_body: Optimized for fast connections and small screens.
account_subtitle: Basic profile info and quick actions.
bio_placeholder: Tell people a little about you…
chat_prompt_4: Teach me a phrase in your language.
chat_safety_body: Don’t share OTP codes, passwords, or sensitive personal info. If something feels wrong, stop and report it via Settings → Feedback.
chat_starter_body: Pick a prompt or type in your language. HeyBuddy will translate for both of you.
chats_help: Tip: Unread chats are shown first. The dot shows if a soul is currently online.
feedback_include_tech_desc: Adds device/browser info to help us debug (recommended for bugs).
feedback_privacy_note: Avoid sending passwords, OTP codes, or sensitive personal info in feedback.
feedback_response_note: We may reply if you include an email address.
feedback_tip_1: Pick the closest category (Bug / Feature / UX).
feedback_tip_2: Describe what you expected vs what happened.
feedback_tip_3: If it’s a bug, include steps to reproduce.
has_bio_only_desc: Find souls who added an intro.
language_note: Changing language updates the whole app. If anything looks wrong, refresh the page.
magnification_desc: Zooms the whole interface for easier reading.
message_sound_desc: Plays a short sound when a new message arrives.
message_vibrate_desc: Vibrates your device on supported browsers.
phone_help: We’ll send a one-time code to your email.
privacy_children_body: HeyBuddy is not intended for children under the age of 13 (or the age required by local law). If you believe a child has provided personal data, contact us via Feedback.
privacy_contact_body: For privacy questions, data requests, or concerns, go to Settings → Feedback and send us a message.
privacy_controls_1: Update your UI language in Settings.
privacy_controls_2: Edit your profile photo and details from your profile screen.
privacy_controls_3: Contact us via Feedback for help, questions, or data requests.
privacy_retention_body: We keep data only as long as needed for the app to work, for security, and for legitimate operational reasons. Retention periods may vary depending on the type of data.
privacy_security_more: We work to protect your data with access controls, encryption where appropriate, and secure development practices.
privacy_sharing_1: Service providers: hosting, monitoring, and delivery infrastructure.
privacy_sharing_2: Legal and safety: to comply with lawful requests or prevent harm.
privacy_sharing_body: We do not sell your personal data. We may share limited information only when needed to operate the service, comply with law, or protect users.
privacy_store_1: Profile: username, phone, and optional bio.
privacy_store_2: Preferences: language, UI settings, and basic app configuration.
privacy_store_3: Messages: content needed for chat functionality and translation display.
privacy_summary_1: You control your profile details and language settings.
privacy_summary_2: Feedback is optional and helps us fix issues faster.
privacy_summary_3: No system is perfect—use the app thoughtfully and report concerns.
privacy_summary_body: HeyBuddy helps you chat across languages. We collect only what we need to run the service, keep it secure, and improve reliability.
privacy_use_1: Deliver chats, translation, and login verification.
privacy_use_2: Prevent abuse, spam, and account takeover attempts.
privacy_use_3: Monitor uptime and troubleshoot bugs when reported.
profile_setup_drag_to_crop: Drag to reposition, and resize to fit your face nicely.
profile_setup_privacy_body: Choose a photo you’re comfortable sharing. Avoid IDs, documents, or anything sensitive in the background.
profile_setup_subtitle: Pick a photo and adjust the crop. You can change it later anytime.
profile_setup_tip_1: Use a clear face photo with good lighting.
profile_setup_tip_2: Center your face in the circle.
profile_setup_why_body: A profile photo helps people recognize you and makes conversations feel more human. If you prefer, you can skip and add one later.
support_note: Need help? Use Feedback to report a bug, request a feature, or ask for support.
themes_desc: Choose a color style for the app.
unread_only_desc: Show chats that need your attention.
users_tip_1: Tap a soul to open chat.
users_tip_2: Messages translate automatically in both directions.
